_comment: Per-item scoring job for the F38-F41 catalogue rows (owner 27 Oct: 'Do whatever is needed to score each biome's cards'). For each item: re-shoot its sightings (up to 3, the catalogue's first-listed, preferring sightings in the item's own biome) on current main with each frame's original repro command, then judge the item one-sided with the standard yardstick. Output contract in README.md.

items.subject: creature collapse and rest
items.defect: Several fainted bodies remain upright or float above the grass and some resting poses do not settle onto the ground

items.subject: creature hurt and movement poses
items.defect: Hurt and moving frames often retain the idle silhouette so the state is difficult to read without a filename

items.subject: fight camera and creature scale
items.defect: The oversized ally often fills half the combat view and hides the trainer opponent or player while some frames clip into creature geometry

items.subject: map
items.defect: The map canvas shows headings and markers without visible terrain or road context for the displayed destinations

items.subject: normal creature scale
items.defect: Several normal creatures read visibly shorter than the trainer in the shared near-framed scale view

items.subject: ground pickup identity
items.defect: Many unrelated ground pickups share small glowing plants, orbs or generic crates, so their item identity is difficult to read at normal camera distance

items.subject: catch aim readability
items.defect: The capture chance and aim reticle sit on the target and busy grass with little separation from flowers and the throw arc

items.subject: Fly carrier grip pose
items.defect: The trainer hangs rigidly upright beneath Galecrest with raised straight arms and dangling legs, so the bird reads as perched on the hands rather than carrying a person

items.subject: menu shell
items.defect: The full-screen charcoal menu with thin teal borders has little visual hierarchy or scenic connection to the illustrated world

items.subject: secondary menu panels
items.defect: The Quests Build and Players panels leave most of their area empty around a few plain text lines or a single button

items.subject: shared fight tell and hit effects
items.defect: Tells and openings rely heavily on text while flat magenta floor marks and bright impact effects obscure creature poses and give weak hit-response silhouettes

items.subject: harvest reward identity
items.defect: Several reward harvest nodes read as generic crates or vegetation without a clear visible connection to their named item

items.subject: catch sequence camera framing
items.defect: The catch camera jumps from a wide aim view to a tight downward view that crops the companion and breaks the player-to-target spatial link

items.subject: catch effect finish
items.defect: The catch sequence uses a dominant saturated magenta ground ring and flat bright orb that lose depth beside the creatures, with little visible change between rest and shake frames

items.subject: flight and landing pose read
items.defect: Flight retains a similar spread-wing silhouette in air and the grounded return shows no bird or perch pose so the descent-to-rest change reads as a cut

items.subject: tournament dialogue subject identity
items.defect: Three differently named tournament conversations show the same grey-haired world character at the same stand despite different portraits

items.subject: named trainer dialogue subject visibility
items.defect: Several named trainer dialogue views show only the player and terrain with no speaker visible

items.subject: craft recipe text
items.defect: Long recipe names and material preview lines are clipped in the crafting list

items.subject: exploration HUD
items.defect: The many dark boxed HUD panels and outlined text occupy a large share of the exploration view

items.subject: Team Tether stronghold
items.defect: The stronghold reads as a small dark ruin behind dominant pylons on approach and as a broad sparsely dressed stone room up close

items.subject: ground cover
items.defect: Thin grass and the same tall white flowers repeat over broad green slopes with few clustered color or rock breaks

items.subject: mill and settlements
items.defect: The mill water is a broad flat blue surface with abrupt sparse banks and nearby settlements have little concentrated visible activity

items.subject: Tether Relay yard
items.defect: Tall flowers and grass grow densely through the flat trafficked relay yard around guards crates and ramp

items.subject: distant mountains
items.defect: The mountain backdrop has hard isolated facets and dark slash shapes instead of continuous landform silhouettes

items.subject: shiny palette distinction
items.defect: Some shiny variants have no reliably readable colour-block difference from their normal form at the device view

items.subject: creature ground contact
items.defect: Dense foreground grass obscures several creatures feet and lower outlines in the normal camera view

items.subject: settings and binding instructions
items.defect: Dense gray-on-navy control instructions and literal key labels make settings and quick binding text hard to scan

items.subject: Warden arena boundary
items.defect: Thick straight turquoise rails outline the Warden floor and cross creature silhouettes like exposed guide geometry

items.subject: trainer defeated presentation
items.defect: The bridge grunt and Warden remain upright in similar neutral postures after victory while banner and dialogue carry most of the state change

items.subject: Burrow Warrens hillside
items.defect: The hillside beside the Burrow entrance exposes a broad rectangular brown terrain face with straight edges and a dark cut

items.subject: alpha rarity read
items.defect: Several alpha variants read mainly as a modest size increase without a distinct staged presence beside the trainer

items.subject: camp and workshop prop legibility
items.defect: Small camp and workshop props overlap nearby signs grass creatures or other tools so individual objects are difficult to pick out

items.subject: catch result hierarchy
items.defect: Catch breakout and success text compete with persistent creature cards, actions and nearby same-species bodies, making the captured individual and outcome focus hard to distinguish

items.subject: placed wall visual
items.defect: A placed wall reads as a featureless cream rectangle with only a thin wood strip at its top

items.subject: human post poses
items.defect: Many named villagers and trainers hold the same straight neutral stance with arms down despite different roles

items.subject: dialogue speaker occlusion
items.defect: Large foreground creatures intrude on the dialogue view and sometimes hide the named speaker

items.subject: Meadows dialogue rock obstruction
items.defect: Large rock faces fill the camera and hide the named speaker during dialogue

items.subject: craft action hint contrast
items.defect: Craft and leave button hints are faint gray on the dark translucent craft panel

items.subject: shore landforms
items.defect: Repeated grassy domes with steep smooth gray rock skirts lack layered shore ecology and clear grass-to-sand transitions

items.subject: Veilfall silhouette
items.defect: The distant Veilfall mountain reads as a near-geometric dark cone with narrow broken waterfall streaks

items.subject: named destination read
items.defect: Several named route destinations read as unmarked grassy slopes or small generic structures instead of distinct halls arches or terraces

items.subject: shiny creature finish
items.defect: Several shiny variants become near-uniform hot magenta and lose their ordinary species material and pattern identity

items.subject: surface swimming trainer pose
items.defect: During the swim crossing the submerged trainer remains upright with relaxed arms and visible boots so the action reads as wading rather than surface swimming

items.subject: creature faint state
items.defect: Several fainted aquatic creatures keep raised alert heads or upright crouches instead of reading as defeated

items.subject: fight actor composition
items.defect: Close-range fight staging lets allies, enemies and sometimes the trainer intersect, so heads and limbs cover one another in several Venn opponent phases

items.subject: Aquaryn mounted-water pose
items.defect: The seated Aquaryn rider traverses turquoise water while the mount stays tall and nearly static above the surface with no visible stroke bobbing wake splash or current response

items.subject: catch camera distance
items.defect: Catch framing crowds the trainer and both creatures during aim then jumps close enough at strike and breakout to crop bodies and lose the orb path

items.subject: water and island depth
items.defect: Broad offshore water reads as uniform light cyan with little depth variation across several island routes

items.subject: Riverdrake fight ground contact
items.defect: Riverdrake crouch and recoil sink its belly and feet into sand or leave the body hovering above a separate shadow

items.subject: authored camp creature bed silhouette
items.defect: The creature bed reads as a flat brown patch inside a dark oval curb and becomes a narrow ring when seen edge-on, with little bedding shape to identify it as a resting place

items.subject: authored camp workbench identity
items.defect: The craft station looks like a narrow plain wooden bench with no obvious tools or work surface cues, and in two camp views it is partly hidden by the trainer

items.subject: swimmer water contact
items.defect: The moving trainer leaves little localized wake splash foam or displaced-water ring while a hard dark shadow sits beside the body

items.subject: Veilfall approach shallows
items.defect: A ruler-straight chain of nearly identical tan discs with white rims makes the Veilfall approach read as mechanical stepping stones rather than natural current shallows

items.subject: live current streaks
items.defect: Live currents use long bright evenly spaced parallel white streaks that read like guide lanes on the water surface

items.subject: current restoration environment
items.defect: The restored current removes the white flow streaks while shoreline sandbars water color and surrounding geometry remain visually unchanged

items.subject: dialogue camera framing
items.defect: At many named conversations the speaker is small and distant in a wide third-person view, leaving the dialogue panel detached from its speaker

items.subject: fight team roster contrast
items.defect: The left team roster fades to pale low-contrast text against terrain during active combat

items.subject: fight background creature ground contact
items.defect: A small blue creature-like figure remains partly buried in sand behind Ripplett through the Venn fight

items.subject: named fight victory hierarchy
items.defect: Named fight victory reward panels sit over the full exploration HUD team roster hotbar and active-creature prompt so the payoff has little visual focus

items.subject: Aquaryn dismount camera obstruction
items.defect: After dismount the camera sits close behind Aquaryn so its back and fins fill much of the view and obscure the trainer and shore-return action

items.subject: catch chance HUD contrast
items.defect: The capture chance label and percentage sit over the trainer and pale grass with weak contrast, making the changing odds difficult to scan while aiming

items.subject: creature rest poses
items.defect: Riptusk and Torrentoad resting poses roll onto their backs with limbs raised and read as distressed rather than settled

items.subject: map active region
items.defect: The current region map heading is shown while the Meadows region tab appears more active than the displayed biome tab

items.subject: dialogue foreground obstruction
items.defect: The player head and back overlap the named speaker in several conversation frames

items.subject: grass around named characters
items.defect: Dense pale grass reaches knee to waist height around Tidewake characters and hides much of their costume silhouette in normal-camera post views

items.subject: fight boss title overlay
items.defect: The upper-center boss title card overlaps part of Cannonback’s shell and head in the opening and tell views

items.subject: dialogue speaker visibility
items.defect: Several named conversations show no identifiable speaker near the dialogue panel

items.subject: open terrain
items.defect: Broad level grass fields and sparse ordinary trees dominate Cloudreach views where layered elevated land and ledge detail should lead the route

items.subject: summit aviary
items.defect: The summit landmark reads as a small skeletal dome on grass beside a separate court instead of a layered stone sanctuary and its night silhouette stays dark

items.subject: architectural landmark read
items.defect: Several Cloudreach destinations present sparse plain or disconnected structures with weak landmark-specific detail

items.subject: exposed landform edges
items.defect: Floating island undersides form blunt dark slabs and several cliffs and grassy shelves have conspicuous straight extruded edges

items.subject: captain fight camera orientation
items.defect: During incoming warnings the camera repeatedly faces an empty part of the arena or crops the opponent and ally so the attack direction and exchange are difficult to read

items.subject: mounted terrace edge and cloud crossing
items.defect: The mounted deer and seated trainer retain their upright riding silhouette while travelling below the cliff and then continue apparently unsupported across the cloud floor

items.subject: grass and stone finish
items.defect: Tall grass intrudes through shrine paving while repeated grass and simple stone surfaces reduce close-range material distinction across sites

items.subject: bright Cloudreach route markers
items.defect: Saturated cyan posts rings and rails at the bridge and flight aerie compete with the built landmarks while the launch platform adds a bright flat yellow pointer

items.subject: named NPC post readability
items.defect: Several named Cloudreach NPCs look small or partly hidden behind the foreground trainer and nearby buildings, with little visible pose or costume detail to communicate their role

items.subject: dialogue foreground composition
items.defect: The foreground player or nearby posts hide much of the named speaker in several conversation frames

items.subject: terrace edge clouds
items.defect: Flat white polygonal cloud puffs cover the terrace cliff edge and read as loose foreground shapes against the continuous cloud floor

items.subject: dialogue speaker visibility
items.defect: Named speaker is absent from the visible world view while the portrait and dialogue line remain on screen

items.subject: catch chance feedback timing
items.defect: A stale failed-catch message remains along the bottom while the new aim state shows 100% CAPTURE CHANCE and a nearly empty target bar

items.subject: Cloudreach map region label
items.defect: The discovered Cloudreach Gate / Lower Cliffs label is cut after LOWER without a wrap or ellipsis

items.subject: floating dark strips
items.defect: Disconnected black rail-like strips cross grass and extend into open air above the Cloudreach void

items.subject: mushroom pickup variants
items.defect: Speed Mushroom and Wild Mushroom use the same pale yellow mushroom cluster silhouette at normal camera distance

items.subject: High Perches rim mushroom
items.defect: A yellow mushroom cluster appears suspended beyond the grassy rim with no ground beneath its stem

items.subject: full-party catch choice legibility
items.defect: The full-party caught-creature choice panel leaves the earlier battle HUD visible through its transparent background and puts dim choice instructions at the screen bottom

items.subject: Stormheart finale
items.defect: The Stormheart finale reads as a dark cylindrical ring with a hole rather than a giant living tree with a branching crown and visible core

items.subject: Surge phase presentation
items.defect: Calm Building and Fading weather stills remain difficult to distinguish while Break reads mainly through darker lighting and heavier rain

items.subject: named wild fight actor spacing
items.defect: Voltarach and Sparkit crowd into the same space so the boss legs mask or intersect the ally and sometimes the trainer

items.subject: named destination identities
items.defect: Several named destinations read as similar grass and trees without a distinct subject in the captured close views

items.subject: forest ground and distance layers
items.defect: Uniform grass and flower carpet across broad flat land weakens the deep wet ancient forest silhouette and distance layers

items.subject: named wild danger and opening cues
items.defect: The bright magenta danger slab remains visible through impact while the HUD announces an opening, giving simultaneous danger and punish signals

items.subject: named trainer dialogue identity
items.defect: Every captured named trainer conversation repeats the same generic line and shows no portrait

items.subject: named character silhouettes
items.defect: Many distinct named roles in Tidewake and Stormwood repeat the same face body and outfit silhouettes

items.subject: harvest resource identity
items.defect: Several harvest nodes look like ordinary stone mushrooms trees or foliage without a readable cue for their named Stormwood material

items.subject: Glass Sink landmark
items.defect: The named Glass Sink appears as an abrupt unmarked terrain edge over a uniform checker-textured void; the sink shape and glass material do not read from reachable rim viewpoints

items.subject: named character portrait identity
items.defect: Portraits depict a different apparent person from the named world speaker in multiple Stormwood conversations

items.subject: charged road surface
items.defect: Thick gold lightning stripes dominate long stretches of road as a repeated flat pattern

items.subject: electric creature finish
items.defect: Fulgocobra and Stormraven lack clear charged material contrast at normal creature-view distance

items.subject: candy pickup tiers
items.defect: Good Great and Rare Candy use nearly the same green wrapped form and scale at normal camera distance

items.subject: dialogue foreground obstruction
items.defect: Large foreground creatures or overhead geometry hide the named speaker in several dialogue frames

items.subject: Hollows fight loss result clarity
items.defect: After the creature falls a large out-of-fight message appears over the exploration HUD while TEAM 5/5 and green party bars still look ready and no distinct loss result is shown

items.subject: Crown Arch
items.defect: The Crown Arch appears as a small square blue frame on an exposed square slab with grass clipping through it

items.subject: uniformed character readability
items.defect: Dark uniformed officers and trainers blend into the purple rainy forest and lack legible rank or individual markers at normal camera distance

items.subject: Glass Field spike bases
items.defect: Blue glass spikes rise from a flat dark base with grass passing through it and a rigid white segment crossing the cluster

items.subject: named character dialogue reuse
items.defect: Distinct named Stormwood characters use identical dialogue lines

items.subject: Hollows victory reward tiles
items.defect: The Hollows victory acknowledgement visually groups with the persistent quickbar so its item tile and four empty binding glyphs can be mistaken for earned rewards
